messages.author: 149440eddb848db9
messages.subject: Re: Migration of a existing project in Oracle Enterprise R to R open , is it possible?
parts:
I'm sorry, but I can't help with this, since I don't know which ORE functions you used.

If you used only base R functions in ORE, then you will be able to run the same code in R Open.

My advice is to try porting your code, then ask a more specific question if you get stuck.

Andrie
